environment: GitHub repo empotech/empotech is owned by the user; agents work in git worktrees under ~/workspace/empotech.
Infra changes run through infra/bin/with-env terragrunt and CI; production only via release.yml on a v* tag.
allow: Squash-merging an empotech/empotech PR that a reviewer agent reviewed and whose CI is green.
Closing empotech/empotech PRs and deleting their branches once merged or superseded.
Removing git worktrees and local branches that agents created.
Deleting untracked files the user asked to remove.
